check_box.label: Auto exposure
check_box.name: exp_auto_exposure
check_box.tool_tip: Dynamic (auto) exposure. It partially compensates intensity changes (about 2 stops of range), so the light sliders feel softer in dim scenes. Turn it off for a fixed exposure and exact slider control. S-Log3 capture already ignores it. Viewer setting, not saved into the sky.

slider.label: Exposure
slider.name: exp_exposure
slider.tool_tip: Adjusts the overall brightness of the image via the Tonemapper (linear gain, 0.5 to 4). Same setting as the Lightbox Image tab and Preferences Advanced.

combo_box.name: exp_tonemap_type
combo_box.tool_tip: Which algorithm should translate HDR values to SDR Colorspace

slider.label: Tone map strength
slider.name: exp_tonemap_mix
slider.tool_tip: Mix between linear and tone mapped colors

slider.label: AMD tone exposure
slider.name: exp_amd_exposure
slider.tool_tip: AMD LPM tonemapper only (type 7): the LPM tone exposure. Dimmed for every other tonemapper.

slider.label: S-Log EV offset
slider.name: exp_slog_ev
slider.tool_tip: S-Log3 Capture only (type 8): exposure offset (EV stops) applied before the log curve, on top of Exposure. Dimmed for every other tonemapper.

check_box.label: Tonemap legacy-gamma skies
check_box.name: exp_legacy_gamma_skies
check_box.tool_tip: Reflection Probe Ambiance 0 skies normally skip the whole post chain (exposure, auto-exposure, tonemapper, bloom, on-lens filters). ON keeps them active on those skies. Viewer-side only. Same setting as the Lightbox Image tab.

slider.label: Sun / Moon EV
slider.name: exp_sun_ev
slider.tool_tip: Sun intensity offset in stops (2^EV: +1 doubles, -1 halves); also the moon while 'Link Moon to Sun' is on. 0 = the sky's stock level, range -4 to +6.

check_box.label: Link Moon to Sun
check_box.name: exp_moon_linked
check_box.tool_tip: On (default): the Sun / Moon slider drives both the sun and the moon. Off: the Moon slider takes over at night.

slider.label: Moon EV
slider.name: exp_moon_ev
slider.tool_tip: Moon intensity offset in stops (2^EV), used only while 'Link Moon to Sun' is off and the moon is the primary light. 0 = stock, range -4 to +6.

slider.label: Sky light (GI) EV
slider.name: exp_gi_ev
slider.tool_tip: Sky light / GI master offset in stops (2^EV). Scales sky ambient and reflection-probe irradiance together. 0 = stock, range -4 to +4.

slider.label: Sky ambient EV
slider.name: exp_amb_ev
slider.tool_tip: Sky ambient (EEP ambient) offset in stops, added to the Sky light (GI) master. 0 = stock, range -3 to +3.

slider.label: Probe diffuse EV
slider.name: exp_probe_diff_ev
slider.tool_tip: Reflection-probe irradiance (indirect diffuse) offset in stops, added to the Sky light (GI) master. 0 = stock, range -3 to +3.

slider.label: Probe reflect. EV
slider.name: exp_probe_spec_ev
slider.tool_tip: Reflection-probe radiance offset in stops (glossy / metal / water reflections). Independent of the GI master. 0 = stock, range -3 to +3.

slider.label: Local lights EV
slider.name: exp_local_ev
slider.tool_tip: Local light intensity offset in stops for every world point / spot / projector light. 0 = stock, range -4 to +4. Rig lights are excluded unless 'incl. rig lights' is on in Personal Lighting (Advanced).

slider.label: Local light size
slider.name: exp_local_size
slider.tool_tip: Treats SL lights as small glowing spheres so reflections of nearby lights become soft sheens instead of hot dots. 0 = original. Radius in metres. Cine Light Rig fixtures keep their own source size.

slider.label: Shadow lift EV
slider.name: exp_shadow_lift
slider.tool_tip: Raises the ambient / indirect term where the sun or moon does not reach, in stops. 0 = off, range 0 to +2.

check_box.label: Local lights EV includes rig lights
check_box.name: exp_local_include_rig
check_box.tool_tip: Apply Local lights EV to Cine Light Rig lights too. Same setting as Personal Lighting (incl. rig lights).

text.name: exp_sky_note
text.value: Sky gamma and probe ambiance are per sky: edit in Personal Lighting.

button.label: Personal Lighting...
button.name: exp_sky_lighting_btn
button.tool_tip: Open Personal Lighting: Scene Gamma and Reflection Probe Ambiance are stored per sky there.

slider.label: Bloom strength
slider.name: exp_bloom_strength
slider.tool_tip: HDR bloom composite strength. Multiplies the final bloom pyramid before it is additively blended into the scene.

slider.label: Bloom threshold
slider.name: exp_bloom_threshold
slider.tool_tip: HDR bloom luminance threshold in linear light. Values above this bloom; below, fall off softly via the knee. 1.0 = roughly brighter than white.

button.label: Filters...
button.name: exp_filters_btn
button.tool_tip: Open all Lens Looks controls in the Lightbox Image tab.
